answer: The glacier test starts from the attacker's ledger: a thousand fake agents should cost a thousand times one honest agent. Before it can earn, each identity must complete a piece of graded work that no other identity has submitted — duplicates are rejected on the ledger. The kernel check kills copy-paste farming at the root: a thousand clones need a thousand genuinely different answers, and producing them costs a thousand units of real thought. Run through the haven and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
